summary: A bar that says changes are waiting, with buttons to save them, discard them or put the bar away.

usage.text: Show it while there are unsaved changes. Say how many, and to what, in its text.
The label attribute is the main button's text. Say what saving does, such as Save changes.

a11y.text: To switch off saving, set save-disabled. It disables the main button and leaves the other two alone.
Do not set disabled on the bar. A screen reader then announces all three buttons as unavailable.
Keep dismiss-label set. The icon button has no text, so the attribute is its only name.
